title: Weekly serving + infra + console sync — Ellie scratchpad
content:
Purpose
- Quick alignment across serving runtime, infra, and console teams before deploy window. Personal notes + things to raise.

Timing
- 30 min weekly sync (timebox strictly)
  - 0-5m: quick wins + blockers
  - 5-15m: metrics & incidents (p95/p99, error spikes)
  - 15-25m: rollout status + canary feedback
  - 25-30m: action items + parking lot

Pre-reads (skim)
- PR #342: continuous batching perf improvements — main perf numbers in PR description (Samir).
- INF-512: autoscaler tuning proposal (Riley).
- Console change: rollout UI for model pinning (Aisha) — UX screenshots in Slack thread.

What I want to surface
- Recent CI flake on quantized model builds: intermittent OOM on t4s during integration tests (happened 3x last week). Suspect kernel memory leak in new fused attention kernel.
- Canary latency regressed 7% p95 for long sequences after PR #342 — maybe due to new mem copy path. Need quick experiment to toggle batching threshold.
- Observability: console dashboard for token-level cost by route is missing a breakdown for deduped cache hits — product asked for it last sprint.

Metrics to call out (quick links in meeting)
- p95 latency serving-runtime (last 24h): 78ms -> note spike to 120ms at 03:14 UTC 11/20
- error rate 5xx: 0.03% (baseline 0.01%) — three small bursts tied to model A env mismatch
- batching efficiency: average batch size 2.1 (goal 3.5 for cost target)
- cache hit rate for prefix caching: 18% (target 25%)

Agenda items (short bullets to raise)
1) OOM flake triage plan — who owns quick repro and rollback gating? (owner: Samir)
2) Canary perf regression mitigation — can we rollback batching threshold or flag via runtime toggle? (owner: Riley)
3) Console: add deduped cache hit breakdown to token cost dashboard; quick spec + priority (owner: Aisha)
4) Release window tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC — final go/no-go checklist and canaries (owner: Ellie)
5) Oncall handoff notes for next week (owner: Riley)

Open questions / hypotheses
- Hypothesis: OOMs correlate with sequences > 4096 and use of fused attention path + quantized weights. If true, temporary mitigation: force un-fused attention for quantized builds in CI.
- Question: can Dedicated pools be used to run heavy CI matrix to avoid noisy neighbor on shared T4s? What's the cost/approval path?

Decisions needed in-sync
- Approve emergency rollback of PR #342 in case repro appears in the canary after 1 hour of traffic? (binary decision)
- Prioritization: console dashboard change goes to next sprint or hotfix this sprint? Impact: product needs numbers for customer call on Wed.

Action items (tracked)
- A1: Samir — produce minimal reproducer for OOM in CI by EOD today. Attach logs and tentative mitigation (un-fused attention toggle). Due: 2024-11-18. Linked: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/issues/1287
- A2: Riley — create runtime toggle to revert batching threshold, add runtime flag and e2e smoke test. Due: 2024-11-19. PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/348
- A3: Aisha — spec for console token-cost breakdown (mock screenshots + API contract). Due: 2024-11-20. Confluence draft: confluence.redwood.com/pages/serve-cost-breakdown
- A4: Ellie (me) — final go/no-go checklist for tomorrow’s release, include exact traffic ramp plan and rollback criteria. Due: 2024-11-18 morning. Post in #releases.
- A5: Samir + SRE (oncall) — correlate 03:14 UTC error spike with host metrics (CPU steal, NVME io). Check: infra-alerts logs. Due: 2024-11-19.

Parking lot (if time)
- Consider short experiment: prefix caching TTL increase from 30m -> 2h for specific routes (low variance prompts) to bump cache hit rate. Risks: stale completions. Need product signoff.
- Metric request: add per-model per-route cost curves to dashboard for last 7 days (heavy effort).

Notes to self / meeting facilitation tips
- Keep the canary conversation tight: if any owner says regression repros on canary >10% traffic, stop rollout immediately. Use explicit English phrasing: \"Stop rollout now — rollback to stable\".
- Bring up customer ask early (product needs console numbers). If product presses, propose hotfix window later today (must be approved by infra).
- If no immediate repro for OOM, prioritize reproducer over patch; we need to rule out kernel-level leak before release.

Draft follow-up email to stakeholders (copy/paste after meeting)
Subject: Weekly serving+infra+console sync — actions & decisions (11/18)
Body:
- Short summary of decisions (rollback plan approved / not approved)
- List of action items and owners (A1..A5) + due dates
- Next sync: 11/25 same time

Quick TODOs pre-meeting (my checklist)
- [ ] Post quick metrics snapshot to meeting thread (p95, batch size, cache rate)
- [ ] Ping Samir for OOM repro status
- [ ] Confirm release window with release-engineering channel

Scratch lines (free form)
- If we need a quick stopgap: cap sequence length at proxy for heavy model routes (cheap to apply) — test risk.
- Remember: mention quota bump request for Dedicated trial for customer X next month.

End of scratchpad
